'''Deddo''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].

==Behind the scenes==
He was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
